exposure: Diffuse abdominal cellulitis after cesarean section
outcome: Resolution of abdominal cellulitis symptoms (erythema, pain, increased temperature, wound dehiscence)
cohort: A 39-year-old female patient who developed diffuse abdominal cellulitis and wound dehiscence six days after a cesarean section.
finding: Serious superficial and subcutaneous tissue infections developed after cesarean section may require intensive care and extensive surgical intervention for successful resolution, especially when unresponsive to initial antibiotic treatment.
mod_finding: The study describes a serious diffuse abdominal cellulitis that developed after a cesarean section, highlighting a potential severe complication linked to this mode of birth.
followup_time: The patient was observed for approximately 36 days after surgical intervention for cellulitis, which developed 6 days post-cesarean section, meaning the last observation was around 42 days after birth.
